description: T015 and T016 - 2x London Plane. Crown lift to 4.5m above ground level by the removal of pendulous secondary and tertiary branches. Works are required to ensure sufficient clearance is provided for construction access beneath their crowns and to facilitate the installation of temporary sub-stations that are to be located on precast concrete slabs on the existing pavement.
